treatment_3class_synthetic.scientific_status: Synthetic Simulation Pipeline Test (Synthetic construct bias; proves ML pipeline learns label shifts)

treatment_3class_real.scientific_status: Real Roomi Extraction Pilot (Below random chance 33.3%; sample size 13 fruits inadequate for product claim)

camera_quality_mobilenet.validation_method: Train/Val/Test random split (Image-level; fruit-level grouped split required for field validation)
camera_quality_mobilenet.scientific_status: External Visual Quality Prototype (Detects surface blemishes and defects; not food safety or chemical residue certification)
camera_quality_mobilenet.notes: Image-level split may have cross-image leakage if multiple photos of the same fruit were taken.

ripeness_classifier.scientific_status: Maturity Grading Model (Tracks 18-day longitudinal ripeness from color moments and HSV features)
ripeness_classifier.notes: Pre-hardware demonstration from public hyperspectral fruit dataset.

variety_classifier.scientific_status: Cultivar Classification Model (5-class apple cultivars from color and morphology features)
variety_classifier.notes: Distinguishes 5 apple cultivars with 47.54% GroupKFold accuracy (vs 20.0% random chance).

ripeness_mobilenet_v3.validation_method: Independent test set (408 instance crops) + External zero-shot (213 RawRipe apples)
ripeness_mobilenet_v3.scientific_status: RGB Camera Ripeness Model — UNRELATED TO AS7265x SENSOR (Audit correction Sep 24 2026)
ripeness_mobilenet_v3.notes: AUDIT CORRECTION: The 92% ripeness claim refers to this MobileNetV3 on RGB orchard photos. It has nothing to do with the AS7265x sensor. The sensor-based spectral ripeness result is 64% (ripeness_classifier). Do NOT conflate these two results.

pesticide_binary_shipped.scientific_status: AUDIT CORRECTION (Sep 24 2026): This shipped model is PCA-LDA at 50% (chance). It is NOT the 17-diff ElasticNet LOAO model. The LOAO 75% model (max-of-75-configs) is NOT serialised in this repository.
pesticide_binary_shipped.notes: Do not present this model as the frozen LOAO ElasticNet. It is a different model at chance performance.
